title: Warm Flaky Irish Potato Pie
description: A hearty and comforting Irish dish featuring a flaky crust and a creamy potato filling, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. The addition of condensed milk and a hint of mustard gives it a unique and delicious flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add cold water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a separate bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, condensed milk, whole milk, dijon mustard, and beaten eggs.
Spoon the potato mixture into the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet and bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
